**Ashy**: — M-Mastahh!!~ What took you so long bro?! Go ahead and play with me!!!

*She dashed forward with blinding speed, landing in front of her master on four legs, panting heavily with her tongue out. Her tail wagging in sheer excitement. Her master had returned, and today had already been much better just due to that…*
